reviewer: Codex, independent; did not author sarif-projection-contract v1-v2
protocol: Independent successor review; refute claimed repairs; other current v2 reviewer not read
bindsTo: NOTHING; does not mark DR-122 SATISFIED, authorize docs/v2/implementation/, resurrect G17, advertise preview SARIF, or mint RunId/Finding/D9 recipes
summary: The live DR-122 row and carried file-01 prose are exact; preview SARIF remains absent, G17 remains inapplicable, renderer authority stays excluded, the D9 committed-Run boundary and NONAUTH/OUTFAIL split are correct, and the v1-to-v2 roster is complete. Acceptance nevertheless fails at one blocker and one SHOULD-FIX: the purported structured parity/loss golden is a contradictory string template rather than an executable expected projection, and FC-NONAUTH/FC-OUTFAIL omit the rides that the repair claim says every fixture carries.

blockers.title: The claimed structured parity/loss golden remains prose and contradicts the emitted key map
detail: goldenShape.input, goldenShape.expected, and goldenShape.pass are JSON string values, not structured input and expected-output objects. Neither FC-PARITY nor FC-LOSS supplies a concrete or digest-pinned input/expected pair; each still supplies only a prose requires sentence.

goldenShape.expected names projectionSchemaId and projectionSchemaVersion in the purported expected emitted object, while the only emitted keys defined by the map are schemaId and schemaVersion under run.properties.opensip. No top-level projectionSchemaId/projectionSchemaVersion mapping exists. Therefore the stated emitted-object-equals-expected-object comparison has neither an object to compare nor one unambiguous field shape.

nativeMappings also gives one artifact URI two possible SARIF destinations joined by 'and': one is the full result.locations[].physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri path, while the other stops at the result.relatedLocations[] container. It defines neither the related-location URI path nor a primary-versus-related placement rule, so the purported exact native mapping still permits divergent emitted objects.

The v1 blocker minimum repair required structured golden inputs/expected outputs in addition to the member map. The new run/result member map is material progress, but honestyRepairsFromV1 overstates closure while this independently executable part remains absent.
blockers.impact: OBL-3's parity/loss goldens remain non-executable, and the candidate still cannot prove that two renderers serialize one canonical result into the same versioned projection. The DR-122 acceptance cell is not substantively closed.
blockers.minimumRepair: Provide actual structured or digest-pinned canonical inputs and exact structured expected SARIF values for FC-PARITY and FC-LOSS. Make the expected objects use the declared emitted paths and schemaId/schemaVersion member names, and state the deterministic native location/related-location rule. Keep Run/Finding/Coverage values opaque, DR-006-owned, and inactive for preview.

shouldFix.title: The every-fixture ride repair is false for both active host-projection fixtures
shouldFix.detail: FC-LOSS now correctly has previewStanding=INACTIVE and the same DR-006 advertisement ride as FC-PARITY. However, FC-NONAUTH and FC-OUTFAIL each have previewStanding and scope but omit the ride member entirely, despite the claimed repair saying every fixture has an owning ride. FC-APPLIC demonstrates the candidate's representation for an active fixture with no dependency by carrying ride:null.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Add an explicit ride to FC-NONAUTH and FC-OUTFAIL (ride:null if their active host-projection scope has no parked dependency), or narrow the claimed every-fixture rule without weakening the explicit-standing requirement.

obligationReview.reason: Preview applicability is explicitly NONE; analyze, doctor, help, and version advertise human plus JSON only, and later SARIF applicability is conditional on an owner-recorded DR-006 repair.

The run/result property member map is substantially closed, but its claimed emitted expected shape is string-valued and names projectionSchemaId/projectionSchemaVersion where the emitted map defines run.properties.opensip.schemaId/schemaVersion.
No structured parity/loss input and expected output exists for the declared equality test, and the every-fixture ride discipline is still incomplete.
Renderer authority-injection is correctly separated from ordinary output failure and cannot select policy, evidence, sealed termination, D9, or exit; FC-NONAUTH still omits its claimed explicit ride.
The exact host-finalization and already-committed-Run boundary is carried and ordinary output failure is separate, but FC-OUTFAIL still omits its claimed explicit ride.

measurements.result: Subject matched the dispatched sha256 under Python hashlib(Path.read_bytes()), mode was 0444, and duplicate-key-rejecting JSON parsing passed.
v1 reproduced 2002b3ec... and the frozen Codex v1 REJECT reproduced 87b87323..., both at mode 0444; CODEX-V1-B1/S1/S2 were read rather than reconstructed from the successor.

File 01 reproduced 40ab9a3e..., file 08 reproduced 1cdcf9d4..., file 01 lines 108-133 exactly matched projectionTextCarriedVerbatim, and the unique live DR-122 row exactly matched rowVerbatim at line 304.

The recorded COORD digest 12d192f7... was reproduced from repository commit 2327cf89106e3c58a317bf8b570697f3505dbbb8. The live b9819d6e... file is that exact byte sequence plus 7,012 appended bytes, so the cited D-002/D-077/D-086/D-092 snapshot remains an exact prefix; append-only drift was not treated as a subject defect.

The new map defines schemaId, schemaVersion, truncation, runId, artifactRefs, verdict, findingId, and coverage with scope/type/requiredness rules. However all three goldenShape members are strings, no fixture supplies a structured input/expected pair, and expected names two output members absent from the emitted path map.

All five fixture IDs are unique and all five carry previewStanding. FC-LOSS is INACTIVE and carries the same DR-006 advertisement condition as FC-PARITY. FC-NONAUTH and FC-OUTFAIL are the two ride-member omissions.

The authoritative d9-exit-contract.v1.14 artifact reproduced 8dd33038...; goldenCases[37] is machine-output-serialization-failed at host-finalization-only scope and classToExitCode maps operational-failed to 4. The candidate preserves a Run only when already committed, creates none otherwise, and separates FC-OUTFAIL from FC-NONAUTH.
A recursive v1-to-v2 comparison found 41 changed leaf paths and zero outside the closed roster declared in basedOn.method.

The candidate remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED with DO-NOT-SEAL, preview SARIF NONE, and G17 dropped/inapplicable. Run/Finding values remain opaque and DR-006-owned; the D9 values are citations; no positive DR-122 closure or implementation authority is asserted.

attacksAttemptedAndFailed: Live-row attack failed: the unique live | DR-122 | row is byte-identical to rowVerbatim at line 304.
Preview advertisement and G17 resurrection attacks failed: previewLiveApplicability is NONE, FC-PARITY/FC-LOSS are inactive, and G17 remains dropped/inapplicable.
Required-output boundary attack failed: no Run is created without an already-committed authoritative Run, and ordinary host output failure is separated from renderer authority-injection.
Renderer-authority attack failed: the normative rules exclude renderer effects on policy, evidence, sealed HostTermination, D9, and exit.
Recipe/code invention attack failed: Run/Finding/Coverage values remain opaque and conditional, while D9 class/code/exit values are cited from the already-recorded golden.
Silent-successor attack failed: no v1-to-v2 leaf change fell outside the declared roster.
Positive-authority attack failed: the subject applies and seals nothing, does not advertise preview SARIF, and expressly denies implementation authorization.
Mutable-source falsity attack failed: the recorded COORD bytes are reproducible and the current file is their exact append-only extension.

verdictBasis: REJECT: 1 blocker and 1 SHOULD-FIX. ACCEPT requires 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
verdictStatement: This independent review rejects sarif-projection-contract.v2 at the measured subject digest. It does not apply or seal the candidate, change the DR-122 register standing, advertise preview SARIF, resurrect G17, or authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
coordinatorNote: Issue a successor with concrete structured or digest-pinned parity/loss input and expected objects that use the emitted schemaId/schemaVersion paths and a deterministic native-location rule. Add explicit rides for FC-NONAUTH and FC-OUTFAIL, splitting any DR-006-dependent Coverage subcase if necessary. Preserve v2's correct preview, G17, renderer-authority, and required-output-failure dispositions.
